assertions.name: A3_lp_degeneracy_breaks
assertions.source: phi(free) 0.429886497, phi(atom) 0.248443512, gap +0.181442985; dual supports 2 vs 3, identical=False

description: Rebuilds the binding LP with the inter-nucleon bonds included, which the previous probes omitted. Corrects the prior turn: atom_gen_chains appends C(A,2) bonds but atom_braid_word_3A places only A-1 (adjacent chain, generator 3k+2), and the chain reading is the one the arity law c_atom = A+1 and Lean ClassicalTraceFloor rest on; the two builders disagree for every A >= 3. With the bond in, the deuteron's Markov trace drops from 0.299015019 to 0.151968341, a -49.18% defect with the correct sign, and the free value reproduces tr_3(p) tr_3(n) to 6.1e-9. Rebuilding the positive-sector LP on a 72-word spanning set (36 product words plus their bond-translates, Gram rank 50) gives phi(free) = 0.429886497 and phi(atom) = 0.248443512, a gap of +0.181442985, and the two states no longer share a dual vertex (supports 2 and 3) where the bond-free LP had identical rank-one duals — which is exactly why every earlier gap was an algebraic zero. L = log(tr_free/tr_atom) is EXACTLY additive over bonds (residual 4.4e-16) with two per-type constants L_pn = 0.676821592386 and L_nn = 0.907262271178. The law gets the mirror ordering right (3H > 3He, ratio 1.17022 against 1.09896, +6.5%) and the A-scaling badly wrong (2H/3He 0.500 against 0.288, +73%).
caveats: THE ABSOLUTE SCALE IS NOT A BINDING ENERGY. A 49% trace defect at 2H sits three orders above the physical 0.1%. These are dimensionless multiplicative Markov traces; converting L into MeV requires the corpus's mass normalisation, which is deliberately not applied here. Only the two RATIOS in A6 are compared with experiment, and nothing is tuned to them.

THE A-SCALING FAILURE IS STRUCTURAL, not a precision issue. A bond-additive law with a chain topology makes 2H exactly half of 3He (one bond against two) whatever the constants are, against an experimental 0.288. So bond-additivity cannot be the whole binding law; the mirror agreement at +6.5% should not be read as validating it. If the C(A,2) topology of atom_gen_chains were used instead the count would be 1 against 3, giving 0.333 — closer, but that topology contradicts the arity law.

SCOPE. A = 4 (he4) is not computed: H_12 has 77 partitions with Specht dimensions to 2673, and word products at that size are not tractable by the dense seminormal route used here. The three nuclei covered (2H, 3H, 3He) are enough to fix both per-bond constants and to test additivity, but not to test the law beyond two bonds.
